correctness.rationale: The known cubic contagion/feedback equivalence is proved directly via inactive-forest leaf deletion. The cubic 30-vertex induced-edge identity gives the sharp k>=8 bound and forces independent seed/tree complement at equality. A tree-median bijection gives precisely one valid exchange per initial seed. Complete C++ enumeration checks all 5,852,925 eight-subsets; separately implemented binary symplectic geometry checks all 111,225 independent eight-subsets and independently repeats the exchange-graph census, giving 12,780 optima, seventy K9 components, 12,150 core and 51,120 edges. A complete 720-permutation S6 computation checks exactly 40 orbits. Source files were run and passed from their delivered standalone names.

It is the exact Tutte-specific census of 12,780 optima, 40 S6 orbits, six activation-time populations and an eight-regular optimal-exchange graph with seventy isolated K9 components and one component of size 12,150. value.rationale: The unique cubic girth-eight cage is the first thick generalized-quadrangle incidence graph, making its induced trees and irreversible seed sets natural sharp instances. The exact multiplicity 12,780 and S6-orbit profile sharpen known existence results; the surprising 8-regular exchange graph with seventy isolated K9 components and one 12,150-vertex component quantifies optimum-layout fragmentation. Synchronous finishing times supply a fully reproducible natural benchmark. No claim of general downstream consequence is needed; exact finite classification and its structural contrast are the value.
